name: Moses' Sultan
summary: A unique Street Racer version of the Sultan, given by Moses as the reward for Collect Moses' Gift.
body: PowerPyx says Moses' Sultan is a unique Street Racer collected from the smaller garage beside Moses' shop in Port Gellhorn at the end of his questline.
PowerPyx says it can be sold or registered and kept.

facts.availability: Reward for Collect Moses' Gift, Moses' shop, Port Gellhorn
